name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
tagline: Comprehensive Crop Insurance against Non-Preventable Natural Risks
overview: Flagship national crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefits: Full sum insured coverage with zero ceiling on government premium subsidy
Post-harvest loss coverage up to 14 days for un-housed crops in field
Mid-season adversity coverage for widespread drought or localized floods
Prevented sowing / planting risk coverage up to 25% of sum insured
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas are eligible.

name: Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (WBCIS)
tagline: Index-Based Insurance Mitigating Adverse Climate Weather Triggers
overview: Protects farmers against adverse weather conditions such as rainfall deficit/excess, frost, heat waves, high humidity, and unseasonal dry spells during critical crop growth stages.
benefits: No field loss assessment delay — payout automatically triggered via weather station index
Fast compensation settlement within 45 days after harvest window
Customized weather parameters tailored for fruit orchards, vegetables, and cash crops
eligibility: Farmers cultivating horticultural crops, cashew, pepper, grape, tomato, or apple in designated weather station zones.

name: Unified Package Insurance Scheme (UPIS)
tagline: Single-Window Comprehensive Financial Protection for Farm Household & Assets
overview: Combines crop insurance with personal accident cover, life insurance, tractor insurance, and farm asset risk cover under a single unified policy.
premiumRates: Integrated bundle rates with subsidized agricultural component
benefits: Covers farm equipment, pumping sets, and cattle alongside crop insurance
Personal accident coverage up to Rs. 2 Lakh for primary farmer
Simplified single application form for 7 financial products
eligibility: Small and marginal landholding farmers with valid Aadhaar & Kisan Credit Card (KCC).
